current_evidence: The council's 'Apply and pay for planning permission' page and the validation checklist consultation page both link this PDF as 'TBC Validation Requirements Final Version Jan 2025', adopted with immediate effect and superseding the previous version; the document text reads Version 5, January 2025.

issues.detail: Grokbot mixed the current Jan 2025 list with the superseded 2023/08 'Local-list-of-validation-requirements-1.pdf' (Version 4, March 2022). Several tab items and app-type rows come from the old list: odour risk assessment, viability publication text, Daylight/Sunlight, Drainage Strategy, Foul Sewage (FDA1), Retail/Town Centre, Transport Assessment, Advertisement illumination, Outline 'Minerals/Waste' and Minerals & waste 'Contaminated Land'. The old list has different NPPF paragraph references and numbering.
issues.evidence: Old-list rows still quote 'Version 4: March 2022' and 'NPPF paras 183185'; the current list is 'Version 5 ... January 2025'.

issues.detail: Eight 'Submission rules' items are invalid-application-charge background and fees from the 'Invalid application charges customer note', not validation requirements. They include the 45% invalid rate, staff resourcing text, the Executive Committee 20 March 2024 decision, the £205/£105/£55 charges, the 28-day rule and withdrawn-application charging. 'We will redact personal data...' is also process boilerplate.
issues.evidence: 'Applications for major development - £205 Applications for non-major development - £105 ... householder and all other development - £55'

issues.detail: A Policy-driven tab item is a garbled PDF fragment. It runs the HRA wetlands text into the item numbers, the Condition Survey heading and the CIL form heading.
issues.evidence: '...sites with candidate status). 7 8 Condition Survey NPPF paras 194, 196, 201 Joint Core Strategy Policy SD8 Community Council Infrastructure Levy...'

issues.detail: The Air Quality Assessment trigger is wrong. Grokbot quotes 'Required for any application for a new agricultural building', which is the trigger for item 3, Agricultural Building Justification. The real trigger is a site within or adjoining an AQMA with 10+ dwellings or 0.5 ha+, or other development over 1,000 sqm or 1 ha+, plus proposals that add congestion, HGV movements or significant parking, emit dust, or bring sensitive receptors into poor air quality areas.

Several trigger excerpts belong to a neighbouring requirement because of PDF column bleed. Drainage Strategy (Full) quotes the Daylight/Sunlight trigger. Retail/Town Centre (Full) quotes the Open Space assessment text. 'Minerals/Waste specific statements' (Full) quotes the Biodiversity trigger. Travel Plan contains '29 Telecommunications Supporting Statement'. The real Town Centre trigger is retail, leisure or office development of 2,500 sqm+ outside town centres that is not in accordance with the Local Plan.
issues.evidence: Item 26 Town Centre Impact Assessment; item 9 Daylight/Sunlight; item 10 Drainage Strategy refers to the Water Management Statement

issues.detail: Several triggers are cut off or carry no threshold. Affordable Housing is truncated before its thresholds (6-9 dwellings net in Designated Rural Areas, or 10+ dwellings or 0.5 ha+). Transport Assessment leaves out the 50-79 dwellings Transport Statement / 80+ Transport Assessment thresholds and the Active Travel England toolkit for 150+ dwellings, 7,500 sqm or 5 ha. The Flood Risk excerpt quotes only the Flood Zone 1 1 ha+ limb and omits all development in Flood Zones 2/3. Marketing evidence ('use e.g. marketing information.') and Advertisement ('hours of illumination.') are bare fragments.
issues.evidence: Items 1, 13 and 27 of the Jan 2025 list

issues.detail: Grokbot placed Drainage Strategy/SuDS, Foul Sewage, Retail/Town Centre Impact and Transport Assessment under Listed building consent. Their excerpts are actually the Historic Environment Statement and Structural Survey text, and none of these four requirements applies to LBC. 'Contaminated Land' is placed under Minerals & waste (county), which is not a Tewkesbury application type. The Outline 'Minerals/Waste specific statements' row is really the Water Management Statement trigger (item 34: all full or outline applications, with exceptions).
issues.evidence: Item 25: 'Applications for listed building consent or conversion of rural buildings outside a settlement boundary ... structural integrity' (Structural Survey)

issues.detail: Ventilation/Extraction is placed under Householder, but the source explicitly excludes householder development.
issues.evidence: Item 31: '...any proposals which include a ventilation or extraction system (except householder development).'

issues.detail: Grokbot placed about 30 requirements under Full planning with the note 'INFERRED: application type not named...', for example Air Quality, Energy, Noise, Lighting, Viability and Open Space. Some application types are wrongly shown as '(none)'. The CIL Additional Information Form applies to householder, reserved matters and lawful development certificate applications that create residential floorspace (Grokbot shows '(none)' for Reserved matters and LDC). The Tree Survey requirement applies to householder applications too.
issues.evidence: Item 8 CIL form: 'including full, householder, reserved matters and lawful development certificate applications'

issues.detail: Grokbot did not capture several local requirements from the Jan 2025 list, by trigger: (3) Agricultural Building Justification, for new agricultural buildings, using the agricultural questionnaire sections A and C. (7) Condition Survey, for LBC involving partial or total demolition. (18) Landscape and Visual Impact Assessment, where development affects the landscape, especially AONB/National Landscape or Special Landscape Areas. (20) Listed Building Drawings, for LBC adding new architectural features, at 1:20 elevations and 1:5 sections. (24) Social and Community Infrastructure Justification Statement, for loss of current or former community facilities. (29) Telecommunications Supporting Statement, for all telecoms development including prior approval, with ICNIRP self-certification. (33) Waste Minimisation Statement, for 10+ dwellings or 0.5 ha+, or over 1,000 sqm or 1 ha+. (34) Water Management Statement, for all full or outline applications except non-residential extensions under 250 sqm, alterations that do not increase building size, and householder development. (16) Historic Environment Statement appears only through the charges note under LBC, not as a requirement for planning applications that affect heritage assets.

The council publishes application-type-specific checklists (Types 1-23, 'Final Jan 25', with Types 11 and 21 revised to v1.1 April 2026), but Grokbot did not read them. As a result, Reserved matters, Advertisement consent, LDC, S73, Discharge of conditions, NMA and Works to trees are all marked '(none)' even though dedicated local checklists exist for each.
Two near-duplicate drawing-scale items, one from the old list and one from the charges note, say the same thing.
issues.evidence: 'Plans marked "not to scale"... will not be registered' / 'Drawings not drawn to a recognised scale...'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current list (Jan 2025, Version 5) and the date is correct. The extraction is poor: it mixes in the superseded 2022 list and the invalid-charges note, has several triggers and app types bled from neighbouring rows (e.g. Air Quality, LBC rows, householder ventilation), and misses about 8 local requirements including Water Management, Waste Minimisation, LVIA, Telecoms and Listed Building Drawings.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
